notes.title: Winter - PlayTest
notes.notes:
Dear players,

We are excited to share some important news about the future of our game *Winter*! Inspired by your support and feedback, we’ve made the decision to completely rewrite the game in order to make it even better and closer to the vision we originally wanted to bring to life. This ambitious update will offer you a completely new level of immersion and even more exciting mechanics.

To ensure the new version works as it should, we will soon be conducting a Steam Playtest. This will be a great opportunity for you to be among the first to experience all the new features, and for us to identify and fix any bugs that might arise in the new build. We will be incredibly grateful to anyone who participates and shares their impressions and suggestions.

Request access now: 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42044369/c888dc07e404eee8a820692966313f89b081467e.png[/img]
[i][h2]Look for it on the game's Steam page.[/h2][/i]

Another important update — the price of the game will be revised soon. So, if you’ve been wanting to add Winter to your collection, now is the perfect time! The old price is still in effect, and we recommend taking advantage of this opportunity before it changes.

Additionally, we’re happy to announce that we’re actively working towards the game’s full release out of Early Access, and we plan to launch it in the first half of 2025. With your participation in testing and your valuable feedback, we are confident we’ll be able to release a product that will exceed your expectations.

Thank you for staying with us on this journey. We look forward to hearing your feedback and will keep you updated with all the latest news!

You can report bugs or share suggestions for the game in this thread: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1919040/discussions/0/4637112710118521881/

notes.title: Game Update: Streamlined Play & Classic Mode Revamp
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42044369/af9200a89c3d46abaa5f0a7f579c6bd170236f71.png[/img]

We have carefully listened to the feedback from our community and chosen a new direction for the game's development based on the feedback received. Our focus is on simplifying the interaction between the game and the players, making the process more intuitive and accessible. Many of you shared your difficulties in understanding the core mechanics and objectives in the game, which became a key point for our further actions.

In response, we have undertaken significant work to improve the Classic mode. Our goal is to ensure that new players can easily integrate into the process and enjoy the game from the very first moments, without getting lost among complexities and settings.

[b]Interface and Settings Changes[/b]
[olist]
[*] Main Menu: The settings item has been removed to simplify navigation.
[*] Exiting Modes: Exiting Classic and Hard modes now returns the player directly to the menu, making transitions faster and more convenient.
[*] Sound Settings: The "sfx" item has been renamed to "effects" to make terminology clearer. The default music volume is now 50%, and the effects volume is 75%, creating a more pleasant audio balance right from the start of the game.
[*] Settlement Noise: We have completely removed this sound effect from the game to reduce audio load and make the sound design more enjoyable.
[/olist]

[b]Redesigned Classic Mode[/b]
[olist]
[*] Economy and Cost: We have reviewed the cost of resources and actions. The cost of hiring a worker, waging war, and the blessing of "Svarog" is now just 1 coin. The cost of building a farm is now 3 coins. These changes are aimed at encouraging more active interaction and strategic planning.
[*] Spawn in Settlements has been reduced by 50%, making the game more balanced and giving players more room to maneuver.
[/olist]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[olist]
[*] Fixed an issue where a tree blocked the construction of a farm.
[*] The Artificial Intelligence (AI) of the workers has been improved: now, with the onset of night, they automatically return to the base, adding realism and improving the strategic component of the game.[/olist]

These changes were inspired by your feedback and suggestions. We believe they will make your gaming experience more enjoyable and interesting. Your opinion is important to us, and we continue to work on improving the game, remaining open to new ideas and suggestions.

notes.title: Global update V 0.1.4.0
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42044369/9784f35756932d067ff18d90a2c0035f94ab5270.png[/img]
[h1]In the course of long development, together with the team, we decided to divide the game into a classic version and a hard version.[/h1]
[b]classic version:[/b]
[list]
[*] fog disabled
[*] snowfall disabled
[*] home totem is disabled, now it does not need to be replenished
[*] chest gives 3 times more coins
[*] monster waves reduced by three
[*] the "lords" summoning totem is no longer hidden and can be activated at any time
[/list]
[u]the hard version remains the same.[/u]


[u][b]Many players experienced negativity, not understanding the process of the game itself and what needs to be done, we decided that the classic version of the game will allow users to enjoy the game completely, easing the complexity and relaxing and enjoying the game[/b][/u]

[h1]other innovations:[/h1]
[list]
[*] instead of the usual "esc" when you press in the game, there will be a menu for settings (be careful, the game is not paused)
[*] the volume of the music is lowered by 50% and too high sounds are also removed.
[/list]


[h1]thanks to all winter players for contributing to the game![/h1]

notes.title: Winter Available Now
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42044369/65bc680558875cd5732624fc22fe9c7171c40877.png[/img]

Winter has been launched on Steam by on March 15, 2022!

[b]Introduction[/b]
Winter is a roguelike adventure game set in a forest among ancient settlements from mythologies. Create your own powerful army and build red-hot walls at night to protect yourself from frost creatures.

[b]History[/b]
Winter will take players far into the past, to a forest settlement where
one day a child was born who was different from the others. The gods noticed this and sent many troubles to the entire settlement. The last leader went crazy and began to send eternal grief to his people, negotiating with the ancient forces, the forces of frost. The merman took all the powers of the frost, but the frost imprisoned this child's soul in a totem so that the child could defeat the merman with his army.

[b]Character traits[/b]
Explore neighboring settlements and annex them to fight the frost.
Hire and train your settlements to mine silver, as well as to prosper your settlements. Random events with the weather will not let you rest, bring offerings to other gods so that they are kinder. Build and upgrade your camp to protect yourself from frost creatures. Learn about the history of Slavic mythology better as you travel through the snowy forests.

The fate of the boy is in your hands!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1919040/Winter/
